summary: Schwartz opens the second day of interviewing on June 4, 2008.

story.community_name: Opening the interview: introductions, date and place

blocks.x: It’s June 4th, 2008. My name is Steve Schwartz from WGBH radio in Boston. We’re at 167 Dudley Road in Newton Centre, the home of Gunther Schuller. This is the second day of our oral history project with Gunther. Thank you for having us back.

Gunther, yesterday we talked – you talked quite a bit about your experience with Duke Ellington, meeting Duke Ellington, and getting to know the musicians and how he worked. I think maybe there’s more in there that you wanted to tell us. So . . .
